name: Daimu
source:
What's your name? Where are you? Why does the scent of iron linger in the air? And most importantly, who is she? Recall memories long lost as you engage in conversation with a kitsune you may or may not know.

[From [url=https://fiendishfiction.itch.io/daimu]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你叫什么名字？身在何处？空气中为何弥漫着一股铁锈般的气息？而最关键的是——眼前的她究竟是谁？与一位似曾相识却又难以确认的狐妖展开交谈，找回尘封已久的记忆吧。

[摘自[url=https://fiendishfiction.itch.io/daimu]itch.io[/url]]
